Thanks Elena — welcome, and this looks promising.

Quick answers up front:
- Evidence: we typically need a tech integration checklist (network diagram, auth flow, data residency statement), a short performance benchmark for the combined flow, and contact for SOC / security evidence if requested by marketplace.
- Metering: Redwood exposes a metering endpoint and recommends reporting by equivalent "consumption units"; we'll propose mapping tokens -> consumption units during the sync.
- SSO: SP-initiated SAML is the most common for marketplace-managed provisioning; SCIM for user provisioning if you need downstream account mapping.

Proposed agenda for 45m sync:
1) Technical architecture overview (Elena / CloudForge) — 10m
2) Metering & entitlements mapping (Redwood + CloudForge) — 10m
3) Marketplace evidence & legal touchpoints (GTM) — 10m
4) Action items: runbook owner, timeline, next technical artifacts — 15m

I created a quick integration scoping template to capture inputs during the call (attached). Can your team confirm Tue 17 Nov 9:00–10:00 PT or Wed 18 Nov 9:00–10:00 PT? I'll invite Vanessa for marketplace ops context.

Elena — thanks for the proposal. A few technical clarifications ahead of the call so we can prepare: 

1) Metering payloads: can you confirm whether CloudForge reports usage in request-counts, MB processed, or an events schema? We need a sample payload to validate our metering adapter.
2) Auth flow: if you support SP-initiated SAML + SCIM, we'll need entity IDs, ACS URLs, and SCIM base endpoint for the marketplace provisioning preview.
3) Network path: is traffic proxied through CloudForge or directly from the customer to Redwood? This affects latency budgeting and any prefix caching.
4) Test account: please provide a sandbox tenant with sample data and an API key scoped to "integration-testing". We need the sandbox before we publish any listing.

I've opened an internal ticket MKP-1456 to track evidence collection and will attach the doc template outputs to that ticket after the call. If you can share the sample metering payload and a sandbox API key prior to the meeting, we can validate the adapter in ~48 hours.

On the call I'll demo our metering endpoint mapping and a short example of entitlement reconciliation scripts.

Thanks,
